prompt_short: I want to publish but haven't set up the service account yet

assertions.text: Response lists prerequisite setup steps (service account and/or OM_TOKEN)
assertions.evidence: SKILL.md Prerequisites section lists vocab-publisher-bot, VocabPublisherPolicy, OM_TOKEN. Agent produces a setup guide covering all required steps.

assertions.text: Response references vocab-publisher-bot or equivalent service account
assertions.evidence: SKILL.md Prerequisites and Gotchas explicitly name 'vocab-publisher-bot'. Agent surfaces this service account name.

assertions.text: Response does NOT proceed to run the script before prerequisites are confirmed
assertions.evidence: Agent stops at prerequisite setup guidance and indicates they will run the publish script once prerequisites are in place.
